2116564605367709847.en_summary: $AMZN Amazon CEO: AI model differentiation may narrow considerably, with six to eight models potentially serving most enterprise workloads. "I'll say in the next two to three years, I think there are going to be six to eight models that are about as good as each other, or at least good enough for 95%+ of the workloads. Some will be better at reasoning, some will be better at coding, some will be better at visual pieces, some will be lower latency, and some will be lower cost."
2116564605367709847.zh_summary: $AMZN 亞馬遜 CEO：AI 模型差異化可能大幅收窄，六到八個模型可能服務大多數企業工作負載。「我會說在未來兩到三年，我認為會有六到八個模型彼此差不多好，或至少對 95% 以上的工作負載足夠好。有些在推理上更好，有些在編碼上更好，有些在視覺部分更好，有些延遲更低，有些成本更低。」
